question_text: Explain the client-server interaction when a browser retrieves a webpage using HTTPS.
solution: The browser acts as client and sends a request to the web server.; The server returns the requested resource or an appropriate response.; HTTPS uses TLS to protect the communication; the browser interprets/renders the returned page content.
